name: Mediterranean Sea
overview: Scripture identifies the Mediterranean Sea by several names including the Great Sea, the Sea of the Philistines, and the uttermost sea, marking it as a significant geographical boundary for the Promised Land. God set the western borders of Israel from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines and the Great Sea, emphasizing His sovereign establishment of the land's limits (Exodus 23:31; Numbers 34:6-7). The sea also serves as a reference point for the extent of Israel's inheritance, stretching from the wilderness and Lebanon to the utmost sea, underscoring God's promise of a vast and secure territory (Deuteronomy 11:24; Joshua 1:4). The presence of the sea in the narratives of Israel's neighbors further highlights its importance in the biblical worldview as a defining border of God's covenant people (Joshua 9:1).
